name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-tryclyde
title: Super Mario World Styled Tryclyde
description:
Custom graphics for that tree-headed fire breathing snake boss from SMB2 that Dahnamics recreated some time ago in SMW style. Check the readme if you want the sprite to make use of most the graphics.

Credit's optional, just don't claim it as your own.

Moderator's Note : It might be a good idea to check your Tryclyde sprite to make sure it's on the right pal setting.
